name: Lancaster House of Pizza
tagline: Classic and specialty pizzas, calzones, grinders, wraps and more on Summer Street in Lancaster, NH. Pickup or delivery.
seo_title: Lancaster House of Pizza | Pizza, Grinders & Wraps in Lancaster, NH
seo_desc: Lancaster House of Pizza, 281 Summer St, Lancaster NH. Specialty pizzas, calzones, grinders, wraps, pasta and more. Pickup or delivery. Call (603) 788-0964.
about: The menu at Lancaster House of Pizza is full of flavorful pizza dishes, from classic favorites to more adventurous options like Mediterranean, Greek, Seafood Lovers and Chicken Fiesta.
Stop by in the Lancaster area, or order online for pickup or delivery.
delivery: Pickup and delivery are both available. Order online or call.

findings: Auto-generated Beyond Menu site; About text is generic and there are no photos of the shop.
Only pizza and specialty pizza items were readable on the menu page we could fetch; appetizers, salads, calzones, subs, grinders, wraps, burgers, pasta, kids and desserts appear as headings only.
A separate, unofficial site (orderlancasterhouseofpizza.com) lists a Vermont phone number; the new site links only to the shop's own order page and (603) 788-0964.
No photos were published: the only images on the site are vendor stock paths.
questions: Please send the full menu: only pizza was readable online, so other sections are not shown.
Hours: the order page showed Mon-Thu 11-8, Fri-Sat 11-9, Sun closed. Are those current?
